links.outcome: Alignment of model confidence scores with correctness of seizure classification
links.effect: All models reported high confidence scores (median 8.0–9.0) that were poorly aligned and did not correlate with correctness.
links.quote: All models reported high confidence scores (median 8.0–9.0) that were poorly aligned and did not correlate with correctness.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic performance and confidence calibration of multimodal LLMs in classifying epileptic versus functional seizures from patient smartphone videos, but it evaluates standalone model accuracy without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
